summary: Focused frontend re-verification of the reported 'admin login webpage not working' bug. All 6 checks passed: login page loads, demo box shows admin credential hint, admin login (chennakeshavaediga@gmail.com/admin123) reaches dashboard-page, logout returns to login page, wrong password shows login-error 'Invalid email or password', re-login works, chef@kitchen.com/demo123 works, session persists after reload, and admin-only /admin page loads with user list (no console/UI errors). Also spot-checked playbook auth items via backend/DB: bcrypt hash is $2b$12$, seed.py updates existing admin password if changed, lockout returns 429. No full backend suite re-run (per request).

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout key uses request.client.host (internal ingress IP, which rotates across pods: observed 10.208.134.66 and .70). Counters fragment across IPs, so lockout triggered only after ~7-13 failed attempts instead of 5. Use X-Forwarded-For or key on email only.

Playbook expectations not met: allow_credentials=False with allow_origins=['*'] and no httpOnly access_token cookie set on login (token returned in body and stored in localStorage kitchen_token). get_current_user already reads a cookie fallback that is never set. Functional but weaker than playbook (XSS token exposure); confirm intended design.

action_items: Optional: key login lockout on email (or X-Forwarded-For) instead of request.client.host so the 5-attempt policy is deterministic.
Optional cleanup: /admin user list contains leftover TEST_User_* and QA User accounts from prior test iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login lockout identifier is unreliable behind the k8s ingress (client.host is a rotating internal pod IP).
Login response returns JWT in JSON for localStorage storage; no httpOnly cookie is issued even though get_current_user supports cookie auth — dead code path / weaker security posture.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared login_attempts collection (3 docs incl. transient TEST_lockout@kitchen.com entries) after lockout probe so no account remains throttled.
test_credentials: admin: chennakeshavaediga@gmail.com/admin123 (verified via UI); chef@kitchen.com/demo123 (verified via UI)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login bug is fixed and verified end-to-end via the public URL. Note: if you probe failed-login lockout, clear db.login_attempts afterwards (identifier is '<pod-ip>:<email>'), otherwise real accounts can be throttled for 15 min. Full backend suite (79 tests) passed in iteration_1; it was not re-run here.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: user typed 'admin123@kitchen.com' as the email because the login demo box did not list admin credentials, producing repeated 401s and stale login_attempts lockout rows. Fix (admin hint on login card + cleared lockout rows) verified working; UI login now succeeds and dashboard renders.
